text:
ravi: late watercooler q  anyone got an underrated documentary or a vinyl recommendation that feels like a cozy discovery? bonus points for <2h docs or albums you can actually find on used racks.

tasha: doc rec: "20 Feet from Stardom" if you somehow missed it. amazing backstory, under 90min, music feels like the main character.

emily: vinyl rec: find a used pressing of 'Transit' by New Order  early 80s synth pop that's great on a rainy day. cheap finds sometimes.

harold: underrated doc: "The Barkley Marathons: The Race That Eats Its Young"  absurd endurance cult, ~1h45, wild.

ravi: adding a quick movie-for-two-hours: 'Columbus' (2017)  architecture + quiet vibes, 1h40.

emily: vinyl bargain alert: crate-dig for 'The Incredible String Band'  weird folk, sounds great on vintage turntables.

tasha: short book rec (<200p): 'Stoner' by John Williams  quietly devastating, perfect for a single-session read.

vinyl-bot: [AUTO] local record shops with great used bins: SpinCycle (Oak St), Harbor Vinyl (Market), Loop Records (placeholder link).

harold: guilty-pleasure single: 'How Bizarre'  OMC  instant nostalgic mood lift. sing along while debugging. :microphone:

emily: if anyone wants, I can scan my shelf tonight and post pics of a few cheap gems i'm willing to trade.

ravi: vote: yes pls, would love a real-world crate-dig thread.

tasha: quick TV ep rec (20-50m): "Dublin Murders" S1E1  moody, feels like a short novel per episode.

giphy-bot: [GIF: stack of records spinning into a sunbeam  big heart reaction]

harold: tiny logistics note: if you're swapping physical stuff, use the #swap-shelf channel and tag logistics for drop-off. saves mail.

emily: cool, i'll post album pics and approximate condition (VG+, Good).

ravi: perfect thread. thanks folks  now i have a doc + album for Sunday tea. good finds!
